updates.refined_candidate: context-indexed, authority-scoped, validity-gated method frontier with non-forced parallel local views
updates.reason: EvoSkill already implements Pareto frontier retention of agent programs with held-out validation and reports skill transfer.
updates.next_discriminator: Freeze known-answer worlds distinguishing a global Pareto selector from contextual authority-preserving frontier behavior before any runtime implementation.

updates.new_evidence: SkillFoundry and EvoSkill make generic skill acquisition strong baselines. RAKL must beat or complement uncontrolled aggregation/static/global-frontier selection on epistemic failures and cost under matched resources.
EvoSkill and EvoAgentBench strengthen the requirement for held-out transfer; RAKL additionally tracks assurance freshness and evidence-governed authority.

Held-out validation does not by itself establish evidence/source-lineage independence; future assurance benchmark should combine the current lineage-dependence machinery with self-evolution evaluation.
